name: Петя и Волк: дело об артефакте приключений
detailed_description:
Do you want to be the first to unravel the thrilling mysteries in the very first interactive adventure of Petya and the Wolf?

Now’s your chance to dive into the heart of the action! Petya and the Wolf return home with a cat in tow—everything seems fine, until suddenly, Petya’s parents vanish into thin air, teleported to an unknown destination! The friends immediately set off on a quest to find them, embarking on an incredible journey through parallel worlds.

Traveling across different dimensions, the heroes must not only locate Petya’s parents but also tackle tricky challenges, helping the peculiar characters they meet along the way. Face a variety of trials that will immerse every player in this unforgettable adventure.

Each world brings a new story, fresh minigames, and unique puzzles—every step brings you closer to solving the mystery and saving Petya’s family. Sharpen your logic, creativity, and quick thinking as you relish each victory and celebrate every problem solved.

What Awaits You?

  • Diverse episodes and unique worlds—each with its own secrets and surprises.

  • Dozens of puzzles—test your wits and intuition.

  • Unusual characters—some will help, others… might cause trouble!

Switch Between Heroes? Why Not!

True partners complement each other! See the story unfold through the eyes of Petya, the Wolf, and even his parents. And Grandpa? He’s the secret weapon! Summon him when you’re truly stuck.

Meanwhile, Petya’s parents aren’t sitting idle—they’re fighting their way back home, but every move takes them deeper into the unknown. Each character adds their own flavor to the story, where every puzzle and mystery intertwines, creating a truly unique gaming experience.

A Richly Crafted Adventure

  • Written by professional storytellers & game designers—pay attention to dialogues; they always matter!

  • Fully voiced by the original cast from the Adventures of Petya and the Wolf animated series—listen closely for valuable hints!

  • Attention to detail is key—secrets hide in the smallest clues, and solving them might just save Petya’s family… and the world!

Key Features:

✔ Engaging story—a mix of mystery, humor, and heartwarming moments.
✔ Brain-teasing puzzles—logic, creativity, and teamwork required!
✔ Dynamic character-switching—see the story from multiple perspectives.
✔ Original voice acting—bringing the beloved characters to life.
✔ Hidden secrets & rewards—explore carefully to uncover everything!
